description: Format capability matrix for PRPM converters - defines which subtypes each format supports and progressive disclosure fallbacks

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Cursor uses simple .cursorrules files. No native support for advanced package types.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.notes: Claude Code supports skills, agents, and plugins. Full agents.md support for progressive disclosure.

continue.name: Continue
continue.notes: Continue uses simple prompt files. No native support for advanced package types.

windsurf.name: Windsurf
windsurf.notes: Windsurf uses markdown rules with 12K character limit. No advanced package support.

copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
copilot.notes: GitHub Copilot uses simple instruction files. No advanced package support.

kiro.name: Kiro AI
kiro.notes: Kiro supports agents in .kiro/agents/ directory. Full agents.md support.

gemini.name: Gemini Code Assist
gemini.notes: Gemini uses extensions in gemini_extensions.json. No agents.md support.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.notes: OpenCode supports agents with mode/model/temperature config. Full agents.md support.

ruler.name: Ruler
ruler.notes: Ruler supports agents in .ruler/agents/ directory. Full agents.md support.

droid.name: Factory Droid
droid.notes: Factory Droid supports both skills and agents. Full agents.md support.

trae.name: Trae
trae.notes: Trae uses simple markdown rules. No advanced package support.

aider.name: Aider
aider.notes: Aider uses CONVENTIONS.md for coding standards. No advanced package support.

zencoder.name: Zencoder
zencoder.notes: Zencoder uses simple rules with glob patterns. No advanced package support.

replit.name: Replit Agent
replit.notes: Replit Agent supports agents in .replit_agent_instructions.md. Full agents.md support.

agents.md.name: agents.md (Universal)
agents.md.notes: Universal agents.md format - works with OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, and most AI systems.

mcp.name: Model Context Protocol
mcp.notes: MCP is a server protocol, not a package format. Supports plugins via server configuration.

generic.name: Generic (Markdown)
generic.notes: Generic markdown format for maximum compatibility. Supports agents.md convention.

agentsMdSupport.description: Formats that intelligently support agents.md for progressive disclosure
agentsMdSupport.notes: These formats can use agents.md as a universal fallback when they don't support advanced subtypes like skills or plugins.
